extraction.name: MTEB: Massive Text Embedding Benchmark
extraction.description: MTEB is a benchmark for evaluating text embedding models across 8 embedding tasks (bitext mining, classification, clustering, pair classification, reranking, retrieval, STS, and summarization), covering 58 datasets and 112 languages. It provides open-source evaluation software and a public leaderboard to enable comprehensive and reproducible benchmarking of text embedding methods.
extraction.creator: Niklas Muennighoff (Hugging Face); Nouamane Tazi (Hugging Face); Loïc Magne (Hugging Face); Nils Reimers (cohere.ai)
extraction.citeAs: Muennighoff, N., Tazi, N., Magne, L., & Reimers, N. (2023). MTEB: Massive Text Embedding Benchmark. arXiv:2210.07316v3 [cs.CL].
extraction.rai:dataCollection: MTEB was assembled by aggregating existing datasets from multiple sources, including public APIs (arXiv, bioRxiv/medRxiv), prior benchmarks (BEIR, SentEval, SemEval, USEB), Kaggle competitions, and community-contributed datasets hosted on the Hugging Face Hub. Custom clustering datasets were created using public APIs from arXiv and bioRxiv/medRxiv. Some datasets (RedditClusteringP2P, StackExchangeClusteringP2P) were created using available data from Reddit and StackExchange posts.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Secondary Data analysis; Web API; Manual Human Curator
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Existing datasets from BEIR, SemEval (STS12–STS22), SentEval, and USEB benchmarks; public APIs from arXiv and bioRxiv/medRxiv for clustering datasets; Reddit posts and StackExchange posts; Kaggle competition datasets (ToxicConversations, TweetSentimentExtraction); Tatoeba multilingual sentence sets; BUCC parallel corpora; Amazon customer reviews; and other publicly available NLP datasets hosted on the Hugging Face Hub.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: MTEB average scores are biased towards tasks with many datasets, notably retrieval, classification and clustering, due to task imbalance in the number of datasets per task
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Very long documents are still missing; the longest datasets have a few hundred words and longer text sizes could be relevant for retrieval use cases; task imbalance with summarization consisting of only a single dataset; retrieval and clustering are English-only while multilingual coverage is limited to classification, STS and bitext mining; no code datasets for benchmarking code models; additional modalities beyond natural language are not covered; data contamination between MTEB datasets and model training datasets is not controlled for
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Evaluating and comparing text embedding models across a variety of tasks; serving as a gateway to finding universal text embeddings applicable to a variety of tasks including clustering, classification, retrieval, reranking, semantic textual similarity, bitext mining, pair classification, and summarization; simplifying model selection for industry applications and future embedding research
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The authors welcome task, dataset, or metric contributions to the MTEB codebase via pull requests, and welcome additions to the leaderboard via an automatic submission format; versioning at a dataset and software level is used to support reproducibility
